snapshot.title: Add Diagnostic Logs Panel to THCSReviewStep
snapshot.description: Add a collapsible "Diagnostic Logs" card to the THCSReviewStep left column (after the Warnings card). The card generates a structured plain-text diagnostic dump of test metadata, section breakdown, and per-question data integrity. Includes a "📋 Copy Log" button with visual feedback. Uses pure CSS accordion (no Mantine Collapse), existing cardStyle, and monospace log output.
